display_information.name: Tic Tac Toe²
display_information.description: Nine games of tic tac toe inside one. Win a board to claim its square.
display_information.long_description: Tic Tac Toe² is ultimate tic tac toe for Slack. Nine small boards sit inside one big board, and winning a small board claims its square. The catch: the square you play in decides which board your opponent has to play in next. Three claimed boards in a row wins the match.

slash_commands.description: Start a game of Tic Tac Toe²
